bill.title: Secure Rural Schools Reauthorization Act of 2025
bill.officialSummary: Secure Rural Schools Reauthorization Act of 2025 This act extends and modifies the Secure Rural Schools (SRS) program, under which states and counties containing certain federal land may receive payments from the Forest Service or the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) for schools, roads, and certain other municipal services. The act modifies the SRS program, including by extending payments made to states and counties containing federal land through FY2026, providing lapsed payments for FY2024 and FY2025, extending the authority of counties to initiate projects using such funds through FY2028, and extending the authority to initiate projects proposed by resource advisory committees through FY2028.

plain.whatItDoes: This measure would extend and change the Secure Rural Schools program, under which states and counties containing certain federal land may receive payments from the Forest Service or the federal land agency for schools, roads, and certain other municipal services.
plain.whoItTouches: People who use public land, and people who live beside it.
plain.everydayEffect: If it passed, the change would show up in what may be done on that land. Nothing has changed yet. Most bills never become law.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
